kurz: The starch [[staerkeverkleisterung|gelatinised]] on the surface before it could spread out. It tastes floury when the flour has not cooked long enough.
bild_im_kopf: Like paste that hardens outside and traps dry powder inside.

ursachen.warum: The outside swells into a shell at once, and dry powder stays inside.
fix: Always mix starch with cold water first
Pass through a sieve or blend

ursachen.titel: Liquid added to the roux too fast
ursachen.warum: A lot of liquid at once does not dissolve the roux evenly.
fix: Stir in the liquid bit by bit
A whisk instead of a spoon

ursachen.warum: Flour needs a few minutes of simmering until the raw taste is gone.
fix: Simmer gently for another 5–10 minutes, stirring

q1.frage: Are there visible lumps in the sauce?
